properties.text: Bearer token comparison must use timing-safe equality to prevent side-channel leakage.
properties.assertion: forall req: authenticate(req) => timingSafeEqual(req.token, API_AUTH_TOKEN)

properties.text: All /api/ routes except health check must reject requests without valid Bearer token.
properties.assertion: forall req to /api/*: req.path != '/health' => req.headers.authorization == 'Bearer ' + API_AUTH_TOKEN

properties.text: No RBAC: role assign/remove endpoints allow any authenticated caller to grant arbitrary Discord roles.
properties.assertion: forall caller, role: authenticated(caller) => canAssignRole(caller, role) -- no privilege differentiation

properties.text: discord_uid parameter must be validated as non-empty string before any database or Discord API call.
properties.assertion: forall endpoint(req): uses_discord_uid(req) => typeof req.discord_uid == 'string' && req.discord_uid.length > 0

properties.text: discord_role_id must be validated as non-empty string before role assign/remove operations.
properties.assertion: forall roleOp(req): typeof req.discord_role_id == 'string' && req.discord_role_id.length > 0

properties.text: Nickname update input must be sanitized to prevent injection of control characters or excessive length.
properties.assertion: forall nicknameUpdate(req): sanitized(req.name) && len(req.name) <= MAX_NICKNAME_LEN && !containsControlChars(req.name)

properties.text: Role assignment must not allow granting roles higher than bot's highest role in Discord hierarchy.
properties.assertion: forall assignRole(uid, role_id): role.position < bot.highestRole.position

properties.text: CORS must not default to wildcard (*) when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset — must fail closed.
properties.assertion: !env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS => cors.origin == deny_all, not '*'

properties.text: Supabase client must never fall back from service_role key to anon key silently.
properties.assertion: supabase.init() => key == SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || throw Error('missing service_role key')

properties.text: Error responses in production must not leak stack traces, internal paths, or Supabase query details.
properties.assertion: forall errorResp: env.NODE_ENV == 'production' => !errorResp.body.contains(stackTrace|internalPath|queryDetail)

properties.text: Bulk member enumeration endpoint must enforce pagination to prevent full database dump.
properties.assertion: forall GET /api/members: response.members.length <= PAGE_LIMIT

properties.text: API endpoints must enforce rate limiting to prevent abuse and Discord API rate limit exhaustion.
properties.assertion: forall req from ip: count(req, ip, window) <= RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD

properties.text: Malformed discord_uid or role_id must be rejected gracefully without crashing the process.
properties.assertion: forall req with malformed input: server.process.alive == true after handling req

properties.text: roles_assigned and roles_removed in sync response must be disjoint sets.
properties.assertion: forall syncResp: intersection(syncResp.roles_assigned, syncResp.roles_removed) == empty

properties.text: generation parameter must be validated as positive integer before Discord role creation.
properties.assertion: forall createGen(req): Number.isInteger(req.generation) && req.generation > 0

properties.text: Each generation must map to exactly one Discord role (unique key constraint).
properties.assertion: forall g1, g2: g1.generation == g2.generation => g1.discord_role_id == g2.discord_role_id

properties.text: Member's joined_at timestamp must be immutable after initial creation.
properties.assertion: forall member, update: update(member) => member.joined_at_before == member.joined_at_after

properties.text: Soft-deleted members (deleted_at != null) must not be accessible via active member queries.
properties.assertion: forall query(active_members): result.every(m => m.deleted_at == null)

properties.text: (member_id, team_id) pair must be unique — duplicate team assignments must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall assign(m, t): !exists(MemberTeamRelation where member_id==m && team_id==t) || reject('duplicate')

properties.text: Each team must have at most one leader (team_id is unique key in TeamLeader).
properties.assertion: forall t: count(TeamLeader where team_id == t) <= 1

properties.text: Team leader must be a member of that team before leader assignment.
properties.assertion: forall assignLeader(member, team): exists(MemberTeamRelation where member_id==member && team_id==team)

properties.text: Deleting a team must cascade-delete all MemberTeamRelation and TeamLeader references.
properties.assertion: forall deleteTeam(t): after => !exists(MemberTeamRelation where team_id==t) && !exists(TeamLeader where team_id==t)

properties.text: After role sync, response success=true implies roles_assigned and roles_removed are valid arrays.
properties.assertion: forall syncResp: syncResp.success == true => Array.isArray(syncResp.roles_assigned) && Array.isArray(syncResp.roles_removed)

properties.text: After nickname update, success=true implies the new nickname was persisted to Discord.
properties.assertion: forall nicknameResp: nicknameResp.success == true => discord.getMember(uid).nickname == nicknameResp.updated_nickname

properties.text: is_in_server=false implies current_nickname is null and current_roles is empty array.
properties.assertion: forall statusResp: !statusResp.is_in_server => statusResp.current_nickname == null && statusResp.current_roles == []

properties.text: All Supabase queries must use parameterized inputs — no string concatenation with user data.
properties.assertion: forall query(q, params): q.uses_parameterized_binding(params) && !q.contains_string_concat(user_input)

properties.text: Privileged operations (role assign/remove, generation create) must produce audit log entries.
properties.assertion: forall privilegedOp(caller, action, target): after => exists(auditLog where actor==caller && op==action && target==target)

properties.text: Discord API failures during role assign/remove must not leave partial state (assign succeeded but DB not updated).
properties.assertion: forall roleOp: discordSuccess XOR rollback => db.state_consistent && discord.state_consistent

properties.text: Attacker-supplied discord_uid must not enable access to other users' data (IDOR via uid parameter).
properties.assertion: forall req(uid): response_data.discord_uid == req.discord_uid && no_side_effect_on_other_uids

properties.text: Discord role list response must contain only roles with unique IDs and non-negative positions.
properties.assertion: forall roleListResp: unique(roleListResp.roles.map(r => r.id)) && roleListResp.roles.every(r => r.position >= 0)

properties.text: Soft-deleted members must not be re-activated without explicitly clearing deleted_at.
properties.assertion: forall reactivate(member): member.deleted_at != null => must set member.deleted_at = null explicitly before status update

properties.text: Member.generation must reference a valid GenerationRole.generation — orphan references must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall member: member.generation != null => exists(GenerationRole where generation == member.generation)

properties.text: Bulk role sync must not exceed Discord API rate limits — must implement backoff or queuing.
properties.assertion: forall syncAll: discord_api_calls_per_second(syncAll) <= DISCORD_RATE_LIMIT

properties.text: name_only in nickname response must be a substring derived from full_nickname — no arbitrary data injection.
properties.assertion: forall nicknameResp: full_nickname.includes(nicknameResp.name_only)

properties.text: Member must not be soft-deleted when performing role sync or status lookup operations.
properties.assertion: forall memberOp(uid): member = lookup(uid) => member.deleted_at == null || reject('member inactive')
